verdict.rationale: Filee documents watch folders that automatically convert files landing in a folder and can move the originals aside, which is a first-party, unattended background automation. Evidence is a single marketing line limited to folder-triggered conversion, and it does not show how the automation is configured or that it runs in the background without the app open. The CLI with --json output and exit codes lets users script conversions, but that is a building block, not autonomous automation. missing for 10: documentation of watch-folder setup and options, evidence of background/service operation, scheduled or other trigger types, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
